title: Common regulatory targets of NFIA, NFIX and NFIB during postnatal cerebellar development
model_or_tissue: mouse postnatal cerebellar granule neuron progenitors
perturbation_or_design: NFIA/NFIB/NFIX binding in P7 GNPs; study reports integration with Nfia/Nfix-deficient GNP transcriptomics
recommended_use: Define NFIA direct-target/regulatory prior for cerebellar granule progenitors; compare target genes with our granule construction and fate modules.
caveat: GEO sample list is ChIP-seq-centered; perturbation RNA-seq availability needs paper/supplement check before full causal fitting.

title: Regional gene expression profiling upon loss of NFIA in adult astrocytes
model_or_tissue: mouse olfactory bulb, hippocampus, cortex, brainstem astrocytes
perturbation_or_design: conditional NFIA knockout in adult astrocytes including hippocampus
recommended_use: Use as a niche/glial NFIA perturbation signature, especially for hippocampal astrocyte context.
caveat: Not neuronal and not granule lineage; useful for niche/regulatory support, not direct granule morphology causality.

title: Dynamic Chromatin Alteration Induces Oncogenic Hijacking by Essential Transcriptional Factors during Medulloblastoma Tumorigenesis [ATAC-Seq]
model_or_tissue: mouse GNP-to-SHH-medulloblastoma models and medulloblastoma cell lines
perturbation_or_design: siNfia and siNfib in mouse SHH-medulloblastoma cell line; GNP/tumor chromatin states
recommended_use: Test whether NFIA-linked regulatory accessibility in SHH-medulloblastoma overlaps our cerebellar granule construction/fate modules.
caveat: Tumor context; not normal developmental granule-cell morphology.

title: Role of NTRK2 on ReNcelVM differentiation
model_or_tissue: human ReNcell VM neural progenitor/stem cell line
perturbation_or_design: NTRK2 knockout; BDNF versus vehicle at 3h and 24h
recommended_use: Build BDNF/TrkB causal-response signature for human neural progenitor differentiation; compare with dentate and cerebellar stage-window signatures.
caveat: Not dentate/cerebellar granule lineage; cell-line model.

title: A TrkB and TrkC partial agonist prevents synaptic plasticity deficits and elicits activity-dependent synaptic and microglial transcriptomic changes
perturbation_or_design: TrkB/TrkC partial agonist treatment
recommended_use: Use as hippocampal BDNF/TrkB pathway response validation, especially synaptic/plasticity modules.
caveat: Disease/plasticity context, not developmental granule fate; requires metadata triage before use.

title: BDNF augmentation reverses cranial radiation therapy-induced cognitive decline and neurodegenerative consequences
perturbation_or_design: BDNF augmentation with or without cranial radiation therapy
recommended_use: Use as hippocampal spatial BDNF-response evidence and compare with dentate neurogenesis/readiness modules.
caveat: Radiation injury/rescue context; not clean developmental perturbation.

title: Chronic Crebbp knockout in cerebellar granule neuron precursors [development]
perturbation_or_design: Math1/Atoh1-lineage Crebbp knockout; associated Bdnf down-regulation
recommended_use: Use as cerebellar GNP developmental perturbation that connects chromatin regulation, Bdnf, and granule precursor development.
caveat: Not BDNF perturbation itself; array-based and Crebbp-centered.

title: Neural precursor cell-secreted TGF-beta2 subverts inflammatory program during CNS autoimmunity
perturbation_or_design: NPC treatment; TGF-beta2 knockout NPCs are ineffective in vivo/in vitro
recommended_use: Use as secreted TGF-beta2 causal niche signature, relevant to conditioned-medium logic.
caveat: Responder cells are monocyte-derived dendritic/myeloid cells, not granule cells.

title: TGF-beta and IL-4+IL-13 induce neuroplasticity in an in vitro model of hPSC-derived sensory neurons
perturbation_or_design: TGF-beta and cytokine treatments
recommended_use: Use as neuronal TGF-beta response signature for neurite/plasticity modules.
caveat: Sensory neuron/asthma model, not hippocampal or cerebellar granule lineage.

title: Wnt Activation and Dual SMAD Inhibition for hindbrain-like neural stem cells [scRNA-seq]
model_or_tissue: human iPSC-derived hindbrain-like neural stem cells
perturbation_or_design: Wnt activation and dual SMAD inhibition
recommended_use: Use as hindbrain/cerebellar-region stem-cell SMAD/Wnt context signature.
caveat: Pathway-patterning model rather than TGFB ligand perturbation; not mature granule cells.

title: Norrin-dependent gene expression in cerebellar granule neuron progenitors
model_or_tissue: mouse P6 cerebellar GNPs and Ptch medulloblastoma
perturbation_or_design: WT, Ptch+/-, Ndp knockout, Ndp knockout/Ptch+/- GNP and tumor comparisons
recommended_use: Use as direct cerebellar GNP/Ptch-SHH pathway perturbation context; strong candidate for causal extension.
caveat: Array-based and includes stromal/Norrin axis, not pure SHH ligand treatment.

title: Germline ELP1 deficiency sensitizes cerebellar granule neuron progenitors to SHH medulloblastoma
perturbation_or_design: Elp1 deficiency in GNP/SHH-medulloblastoma genetic model
recommended_use: Use as GNP susceptibility/proliferation perturbation linked to SHH medulloblastoma.
caveat: Cancer-predisposition context; useful for proliferation/fate, not final normal morphology.

title: Transcriptomic changes induced by Gsk-3 deletion in cerebellar progenitors
perturbation_or_design: Gsk-3 deletion in CGNPs
recommended_use: Use as cerebellar progenitor proliferation/differentiation perturbation related to SHH-responsive CGNP biology.
caveat: Not direct SHH ligand/receptor perturbation; pathway is indirect.

title: Prdm16 regulation of Shh-Gli1-Hoxc4 signaling is required for GNP expansion and cerebellar behavior
perturbation_or_design: Prdm16 conditional deletion
recommended_use: Use as cerebellar GNP expansion perturbation tied to Shh-Gli1-Hoxc4 signaling.
caveat: Only two listed samples in GEO summary; likely underpowered alone.

title: Chronic Crebbp knockout in cerebellar granule neuron precursors [development]
perturbation_or_design: Math1/Atoh1-lineage Crebbp knockout at P7
recommended_use: Use as developmental GNP perturbation bridging SHH-medulloblastoma, chromatin regulation, and Bdnf.
caveat: Not direct SHH perturbation; array-based.

title: Bulk RNA-seq of immunopanned astrocytes with Shh and Fgf treatment
perturbation_or_design: SAG/SHH agonist, FGF2, FGF10 treatments
recommended_use: Use as SHH-responsive astrocyte/niche signature, potentially relevant to cerebellar glial context.
caveat: Not granule lineage.

title: RBFOX3/NeuN is required for hippocampal circuit balance and function
model_or_tissue: mouse hippocampus, dentate granule-cell phenotype reported
perturbation_or_design: Rbfox3 homozygous knockout versus wild type
recommended_use: Use as the most direct RBFOX3 perturbation support for hippocampal/dentate granule synaptic and plasticity consequences.
caveat: Only two RNA-seq samples in GEO; phenotype is strong but transcriptomic power is limited.

title: Gene expression profiling of neurons with Rbfox1 and Rbfox3 knockdown and rescue with cytoplasmic or nuclear Rbfox1 isoform [RNA-seq]
perturbation_or_design: siRbfox1/Rbfox3 knockdown plus rescue with cytoplasmic or nuclear Rbfox1 isoforms
recommended_use: Use as neuronal RNA-processing and synaptic-gene perturbation signature for RBFOX-family maturation modules.
caveat: Double knockdown and Rbfox1 rescue; not RBFOX3-specific and not granule-cell purified.

title: Gene expression profiling of neurons with Rbfox1 and Rbfox3 knockdown
perturbation_or_design: siRbfox1/Rbfox3 double knockdown
recommended_use: Use as companion array dataset for RBFOX-family splicing/expression perturbation.
caveat: Double knockdown and cultured neurons; less direct than GSE84786 for dentate phenotypes.

title: Systematic exploration of dynamic splicing networks reveals conserved multi-stage regulators of neurogenesis [SPARseq]
perturbation_or_design: multi-factor perturbation/screening context that includes HMGN2-associated query hits
recommended_use: Keep only as an exploratory screen to test whether HMGN2 perturbation affects neurogenesis-linked expression/splicing modules.
caveat: Not HMGN2-focused in GEO summary; requires target-level metadata extraction before use.

title: Multilayered control of alternative splicing regulatory networks by transcription factors (SPAR-Seq)
perturbation_or_design: systematic linking of trans-acting factors to endogenous RNA regulation events
recommended_use: Use only as a broad regulatory-screen resource if HMGN2-specific perturbation rows can be recovered.
caveat: Not neural granule-specific and not clearly HMGN2-focused from accession summary.
